expects.query: Backend A is configured for max_tokens=100 but stops naturally after 18 tokens. Backend B generates exactly 100 tokens. A reports more streams. Can I conclude A has better OSL-100 capacity?
checks: The response classifies the comparison as invalid rather than a confirmed capacity improvement.
The response distinguishes the max_tokens configuration from the actual number of generated output tokens.
The response requires matched generated-token counts or an explicit fixed-length EOS policy before profiling or comparing capacity.
